# Dion Group

> Dion Group is a venture foundry and software studio that builds operational SaaS products and custom software for companies. Based in Greece, working internationally (English, German, Greek).

## What Dion Group does
- Builds and operates its own SaaS products (see Products below).
- Designs and builds **custom software** for companies: web applications, operational platforms, dashboards, internal tools, and end-to-end digital systems — from concept to deployment.
- Areas of expertise: logistics and transport operations, terminal/yard management, workflow and document automation, and AI-assisted tooling.

## Products
- **Axon TMS** — https://dion-group.com/tms/axon.html — a Terminal / Transport Management System: the single operational record for a truck yard. It governs gate check-in, warehouse loading, documents (CMR), and release across one record per truck, in real time. Use cases: truck management, yard management, dock/gate scheduling, fleet and logistics operations, freight document automation. Pricing from €500/month per yard.
- **Aegis** — an AI product, currently in development.

## Services (for companies looking to build custom programs/software)
Dion Group partners with businesses that want a custom program, app, internal system, or website built. Typical engagements: custom web apps, logistics/operations software, automation tools, and tailored SaaS. Contact via the form below to discuss a build.
